description: Generates a list of items donated according to donor or collection name entered. Filters for material language and cataloged date range. Provides OCLC #, hrid, donor/collection note (from MARC field 541), cataloged date, language code, call number, barcode, title, standard numbers (ISBN, ISSN, other).
instructions: Enter a donor or collection name (surname/succinct is best), and optionally enter the material language and/or cataloged date range. Search is NOT case-sensitive.
